card.name: Start of drug names beginning with f
card.fires_on: The lone letter f (or F) that opens a drug name such as furosemide, fentanyl or fesoterodine, in lists of interacting drugs. The rest of the name follows in the next piece.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word pieces starting with f, such as inf, fi or fm, and away from other consonant-ir pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of drug names like furosemide and fentanyl when the name is split up.
